testflight.whats_new: 1.0.5 again, for testing. New in this build: on the daily puzzle, Answer asks first, since it ends the day and your streak (Keep trying goes back to the puzzle); a daily played as your very first puzzle shows how to move a piece; buttons in Chinese, Japanese and Korean dialogs no longer break mid-word. From the last build: practice sets can be ended early from their chip, hints go move by move (the piece, then the arrow), a card says when the coach is ready, the sound comes back if iOS left it silent, and play counts made offline are sent once you're back online. Tell me anything that's broken or reads wrong.

note: HOLD (owner, 2026-11-23): 1.0.5 is on TestFlight only while the owner tests it; this build (2026-11-26) adds the daily's Answer question, the how-to-move tip on a first daily, and TestFlight's stats counted apart. Nothing goes to App Review until the owner says so; then rename app_store_held back to app_store and push.
